name: Lola Indus
source:
Lola is a normal girl from the town of Ice in the free cities alliance. She's selfish, loud, obnoxious, and hates to follow orders. She is the daughter of Jingle Takashi Indus.

[spoiler]Under unclear circumstances, she somehow met with the Lis Round One named [url=/c97348]Wuu[/url]. They both became close, and despite the vast differences between the two, they fell in love with each other and decided to ran away together, since they knew her parents wouldn't accept their relationship, hiding in the Lis Cave to the north of Ice. Her father asked a petition to the Keith Guild to rescue his daughter, thinking she was kidnapped by a monster, mission that ended up being accepted by a money starving Rance.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Rola_Indus]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
